businesses.business: mechanical, electrical and plumbing contracting and building systems services

offering_description.value: Provides design, engineering, installation and maintenance of HVAC, plumbing, piping and electrical systems for commercial, institutional and industrial buildings. Also offers ongoing maintenance, repair and energy-efficiency services for building owners. Work is delivered through its own project teams and skilled trades.

primary_services.value: mechanical, electrical and plumbing contracting; HVAC design-build and installation; building systems maintenance and repair; energy efficiency and retrofit services; engineering and construction management

customer_segment.value: B2B: building owners, healthcare systems, data centers, manufacturers, universities, commercial developers and general contractors; B2G: public schools, government facilities and other public institutions

end_markets.value: healthcare; data centers; education; manufacturing and life sciences; commercial and government buildings

revenue_model.value: project or contract: fixed-price and cost-plus construction and installation contracts for building systems; service fees: recurring maintenance, repair, service agreements and energy services for building owners

value_chain_position.value: service provider: buys equipment and materials and employs skilled trades to install and service building systems for owners and contractors

geography_served.value: US national: Mid-Atlantic, Northeast, Midwest, Southeast, Southwest and West Coast regions, with offices across many US states

specialization.value: related lines: construction (MEP contracting) and owner direct relationship services such as maintenance, repair and energy services

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: bids and negotiated contracts with owners, general contractors and facility managers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: contractor licensing, building and electrical codes, workplace safety (OSHA), environmental and refrigerant rules
